title: Healthy Lifestyle & Science
description: I love maintaining a healthy and active lifestyle. Running is one of my favorite ways to challenge myself and push my limits.
I am fascinated by science and passionate about continuous learning. Teaching and guiding people allows me to communicate complex ideas clearly, combining curiosity with inspiration.

title: Cooking & Gardening
description: Cooking is a way to explore cultures, experiment creatively, and connect with memories and people. I enjoy learning from cuisines worldwide, improvising dishes, and adding a personal touch.
Gardening aromatic herbs recently has complemented my cooking, bringing freshness and personal touch to my meals.

title: Video Games & Creativity
description: I have a strong drive to generate and create rather than simply consume. I enjoy exploring and discovering diverse fields that inspire me to bring ideas to life.
Among my interests, I particularly enjoy creating and playing video games which let me design worlds, craft characters, and refine skills in drawing, pixel art, or storytelling.
